title: Coherent quotient presentations in normalized reference coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W and a coefficient derived system calculus S [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. For a flat-term K-flat integral complex P and a strict coefficient sequence complex C, let e identify S.reduction(Q(P)) with Q(C), and let kappa identify each evaluation of C with the ordinary finite quotient of P. If (e,kappa) is whole-system coherent [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], there is an ordinary complex isomorphism a from the reference ordinary reduction of P to C [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. The reference reduction comparison followed by Q(a) equals the unique adjunction comparison from the reference calculus to S followed by e. At each finite level, evaluation of a followed by kappa is the inverse reference reduction evaluation.

proof.text: Build the reference OrdinaryModel from the actual ordinary quotient functor, its finite evaluation, transition and unit formulas, and the canonical termwise limit comparison.

Use the fixed-calculus derived comparison and canonical normalized constant-limit unit to form a DerivedModel. Its system unit equals the reference limit unit. Transposing the identity identifies its reduction comparison with the uniquely normalized reference reduction comparison on every good complex.

The unique comparison of left adjoints preserves the unit and hence whole-system coherence. Apply coherentQuotientModelComparison with the reference models, and substitute the identified reference reduction comparison.

theorem coherentReferenceQuotientComparison (W : Scheme.{u})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex.{u, u} l E W).FullSubcategory)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E W) ℤ)
    (e : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation.{u, u} l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l E W n).obj P.obj)
    (hc : IsIntegralComparisonPresentationCoherent l E W S P.obj C e κ) :
    ∃ a : (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        P.obj) ≅ C,
      (pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map a.hom =
        ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E W).adjunction.leftAdjointUniq S.adjunction).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫ e.hom ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
          κ n = ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).app P.obj).symm
